slot.brief: Mixed letter-number series where letters shift by a fixed step and numbers follow their own rule; ask for the next term.

stem:
Find the next term in the alphanumeric series given below:

D7W, G12T, J19Q, M28N, ?

verdicts.working: First letters D,G,J,M increase by 3 → P. Numbers 7,12,19,28 have gaps 5,7,9 → next gap 11 → 39. Last letters W,T,Q,N decrease by 3 → K. Next term: P39K.

working:
Break each term into its three components:

1. **First letter:**
$\text{D (4)} \xrightarrow{+3} \text{G (7)} \xrightarrow{+3} \text{J (10)} \xrightarrow{+3} \text{M (13)} \xrightarrow{+3} \text{P (16)}$

2. **Middle number:**
$7 \xrightarrow{+5} 12 \xrightarrow{+7} 19 \xrightarrow{+9} 28 \xrightarrow{+11} 39$
(The difference increases by $2$ at each step: $+5, +7, +9, +11$.)

3. **Second letter:**
$\text{W (23)} \xrightarrow{-3} \text{T (20)} \xrightarrow{-3} \text{Q (17)} \xrightarrow{-3} \text{N (14)} \xrightarrow{-3} \text{K (11)}$

Combining the three results gives **P39K**.
